info.name: compensation Scorecards API
info.description: The Compensation service enables applications to extend Workday's HCM Compensation features.

variable.description:
(Required) The Workday ID of the resource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).
- **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Performance_Scorecard_ID

request.description:
Retrieves Compensation Scorecard information including the scorecardName, scorecardDescription, inactive status, defaultScorecardGoals, scorecardProfiles containing profileScorecardGoals as of the effective date. The default effective date is the request date.

Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus

Scope: Advanced Compensation

response.name: Successful response. A successful response can return no matched data.

variable.description:
(Required) The Workday ID of the resource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).
- **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Performance_Scorecard_ID

request.description:
Replaces an existing Compensation Scorecard as of the specified effectiveDate.
Call GET /scorecards/{ID} to initially populate the request body with the existing data. You can then update the scorecardName, scorecardDescription, and inactive fields. You can also add, update, and delete the existing data in defaultScorecardGoals[], scorecardProfiles[], and profileScorecardGoals[].

Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus

Scope: Advanced Compensation

request.description:
Creates a new Compensation Scorecard.

In the request body, specify these required fields: scorecardName, effectiveDate, and defaultScorecardGoals[ {goalName, goalWeight} ].
If you specify the optional scorecardProfiles[], you must specify the eligibilityRule{id} and at least 1 goal in profileScorecardGoals[ {goalName, goalWeight} ].

Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus

Scope: Advanced Compensation
